item.title: Sample: AI agents start booking travel for business users
item.content:encoded:
A sample report says that AI agents now book about 5 percent of business trips at large companies.

Travel sellers worry that agents will compare prices across all sites and reduce brand loyalty. Some experts think agents will favour sellers with clean data and simple APIs.
